{{Quote|You can count on me.|Nartlo to Kirtan Loor|<ref name="krytos" />}}
'''Nartlo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who sold [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the outbreak of the [[Krytos virus]]. Nartlo was caught and turned into an informer by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]], who was then running the [[Palpatine Counter-Insurgency Front]].

Nartlo [[Death/Legends|died]] of cerebral hemorrhage when [[Fliry Vorru]], head of the [[Imperial Center People's Militia]], interrogated him with the drug [[Skirtopanol/Legends|skirtopanol]], not knowing Nartlo took an excessive amount of [[lotiramine]] under the belief that it would prevent him from the Krytos virus.<ref name="krytos" />
